inlines.v: WHEELING, participle present tense Conveying on wheels or in a wheel-carriage; turning. WHEELING, noun 1. The act of conveying on wheels. 2. The act of passing on wheels, or convenience for passing on wheels. We say, it is good wheeling or bad wheeling according to the state of the roads. 3. A turning or circular movement of troops embodied.
